name: Adam Levine
career_history: Chief Commercial Officer at DATA4, 9/2014 to present; VP Sales, Europe at Digital Realty, 5/2007 to 8/2014; Associate Director at CB Richard Ellis, 10/2002 to 4/2007; Development Surveyor at HRO, 1/2000 to 9/2002

pipeline.project: Long Term Mapping - Sales - Main List

education: BSc (HONS), Land Management, University of East London, 1990 to 1993
biography:
Born in Great Britain, I studied in the UK, where I graduated in 1993 with a BSc (Hons) in Land Management delivered by the University of East London, London. This academic training with its focus on real estate orientated my career in this sector.

I became involved in technical real estate while working as a commercial agent in London in the mid-90’s, before then focusing on IT companies. Still based in London during the period 1998 to 2000 I continued to work as an independent property consultant managing and developing the real estate assets of IT companies and dot.com start-ups. 

In 2000, I moved to Paris where I pursued my real estate career at HRO France for two years as a real estate development surveyor for the group, working on large office development projects mainly concentrated in France, the UK and Germany. 

In October 2002 I joined CBRE Bourdais as an associate director focussing on the technology and telecommunication sector, managing clients such as AT&T and Global Switch.

In May 2007 I joined Digital Realty Trust as the European Sales Director responsible for leasing datacenter solutions in the US and Europe to major companies such as IBM, Capgemini, Atos Origin, BT and Equinix. In 2009 I became VP Sales and Business Development for the EMEA region.

In September 2014 I joined DATA4 Group as the Chief Commercial Officer. As CCO I lead a team that is responsible for organic growth for DATA4 Group through leasing of space, power and services in existing DATA4 Group assets and inorganic growth through the strategic acquisition of revenue-producing, mission-critical assets in both existing and new markets.

Specialties: Bi-lingual (French and English); complex technical lease negotiations; European and UK property transactions; Sales and Acquisition Strategy - creation and implementation; Channel Partner creation; development of Global Alliances and Strategic Partners.
